name: zrndr_draw_textured_queued
description: zRndr_DrawTexturedQueued renders a queued textured polygon through the software rasterizer span path, including palette remap setup and shade-span dispatch.
known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because HLIL still renders some tri-vertex/UV arrays as byte-offset raw loads and some edge-table cursor updates as pointer-to-array or saved-stack pointer math.
VC5SP3 compile-only verification is recorded for the production source body; tier S byte comparison is deferred to a coherent zRndr queued-polygon rendering pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x495850 validates perspective-correct texture and shade plane setup, optional clipped-triangle texture interpolation rebuild, optional mip variant selection, palette and shade-remap selection, span-list builder dispatch, inverse-depth span node setup, active texture globals, chunked textured span dispatch, and finalize callback use.
The native textured queued smoke verifies span-list invocation, textured queued span dispatch, active texture texel and remapped palette globals, positive pixel count, and the fixed V-shift contract.
